pages.text: The brick crucible is an improved version of the stone crucible. It is capable of reaching much higher temperatures, as well as alloying.

pages.name: Foundry Tier II
pages.text: Use the book to visualise how to build the brick foundry. You also need a brick firebox.

You may have noticed that your brick foundry is not reaching high enough temperatures to melt iron. To do so, you need a bellows, to increase the airflow the foundry receives and subsequently raise the temperature your fuel burns at.
Make sure to also use coal. Charcoal does not burn hot enough to melt raw iron ore.
